id: title:charlesvien:say how long a running turn has been silent

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the Slack App conversation UI to display agent activity status and switch shared UI components to PostHog's own library.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a localized UI improvement: P1.F1.H2 adds a `lastActivityAt` prop and state to track agent silence, while P1.F2.H1 switches the text component dependency from Radix UI to PostHog's Quill package. This is a bounded, implementation-visible change.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the `noteActivity` function or the full conversation building functions, so the complete behavior and potential edge cases are not demonstrated. No score 2 or 3 is supported.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new `lastActivityAt` field.
